name: comment-diet
description: Puts agent-written comments on a diet: one line, or none — and one concise summary sentence for a doc comment. A Claude Code hook that blocks useless comments as an agent writes them.

plugins.name: comment-diet
plugins.description: Puts agent-written comments on a diet: one line or none, and one concise summary sentence for a doc comment. Blocks multi-line comment blocks, banners, narration, road-not-taken comments, and bloated Go doc comments, rustdoc, JSDoc and docstrings as they're written, scoped to the current change. Configurable via .comment-diet.json; no dependencies.
